rejected.title: Biological factors in specific phobia
card: A specific phobia is an intense, lasting fear of one object or situation, such as spiders or heights. Biological factors can help it develop and stay.
GABA is the main inhibitory neurotransmitter in the brain. It calms neural activity, including in fear circuits. Low GABA activity means less calming, so fear responses can be stronger.
Long-term potentiation (LTP) is a lasting strengthening of the connection between neurons that fire together often. When a fear is learned, LTP can strengthen the pathway for the fear response.
Each time the feared thing is met, the strengthened pathway makes the fear response easier to trigger. This can help the phobia stay.
rejected.remember: Less calming from GABA and stronger fear pathways from LTP can help a phobia develop and stay.

a.q: Which change in the brain could help a specific phobia develop?
opts: Low GABA activity, so fear circuits are calmed less
High GABA activity, so fear circuits are calmed less
Low GABA activity, so fear circuits are calmed more
LTP that weakens the pathway for the fear response
a.why: GABA is inhibitory, so low GABA activity means fear circuits are calmed less and fear can be stronger. High GABA would increase calming, and LTP strengthens a pathway rather than weakening it.
a.clue: GABA calms neural activity, so think about what less of it does.

b.q: Priya was bitten by a dog at age six. Years later she still panics at any dog, and the panic is quicker each time she meets one. Which biological process best explains the response becoming easier to trigger?
opts: LTP strengthening the neural pathway for the fear response
Raised GABA activity calming the fear circuits further
Operant conditioning rewarding her for avoiding dogs
Stigma stopping her from seeking help for the fear
b.why: Repeated activation of the fear pathway can strengthen the connections between its neurons through LTP, so the response is triggered more easily. Operant conditioning is a psychological factor, and higher GABA would calm fear rather than increase it.
b.clue: Which option is a change in the connections between neurons?
